title_en: 2+1+1 apartment for sale at RiverSide Residence
description_en: Apartment at RiverSide Residence €199,000! The apartment is located in the newest complex in Tirana, designed as a residential and service complex, located in the western part of the city on "Javer Malo" Street and the extension of "Gjergj Fishta" Boulevard. Property information > This new apartment offers functional spaces and high quality construction, in one of the most modern and well-organized complexes in the capital. * Total area: 117.34 m2 * Net area: 95.68 m2 Tr: Organization: 2 bedrooms, living room with kitchen, 2 toilets, 2 balconies * The complex offers high quality construction and security. The complex offers everything you need: green surroundings and a shopping center.
